teams.axes: pos: metres, +X east, +Y north, +Z up, yaw counter-clockwise from above (fronts face -Y at yaw 0). pos_ue / yaw_ue: Unreal centimetres (x, -y, z) and degrees (-yaw).
teams.tags: every building actor: Selectable, Name:<kind>, Team:0|1|Neutral. Markers (TargetPoint actors): TeamStart:0, TeamStart:1, Rally:0, Rally:1, and the contested zones NorthCrossing, SouthCrossing, Ruins.

balance.note: metres walked from the castle's door by the shortest route over the ground (50 cm cells, steps of at most 50 cm, no water, no building; trees not counted). bridges: [from the player's castle to its nearer end, from the enemy's]

buildable_m2.note: square metres of level ground that can be walked to, less roads and buildings. player / enemy: what is nearer (on foot) to its castle than to the other (marked: in the plan's buildable areas and on the hills' tops; open: no tree within 4 m; wooded: under trees, which a building clears). The named entries: each buildable area of the plan.
